purpose: Live-check the minimum V5 combined graph correction on one case selected without performance outcomes from the sealed 30-case mechanism audit.

approval.scope: One immutable 180-second V5 source-selected live probe after the composed audit seals.
approval.confirmation_reference: Standing autonomous authorization for the fixed full-paper scope.

sampling.independent_units: One new 180-second closed-loop execution; source nomination is derived from all 30 frozen V9 cases.
sampling.selection_rule: Among cases with both diagnosed mechanisms, minimize the later of the first re-anchor-proxy frame and first nonmatching-frontier frame; tie by case ID.

method.main: V9 learned structure directions plus frozen B0 count/role, verified causal re-anchor, and causal frontier execution feedback into the existing retry ledger.
method.baseline: The exact sealed defective-V9 source case is mechanism evidence only; original M-TARE remains the primary performance baseline for later randomized-block comparison.
method.fallback: None. Failure to activate at least one source-diagnosed correction or to make route progress afterward fails the probe.
method.thresholds: Reuse the frozen 180-second readiness gates and existing retry penalty; no new research threshold or planner weight.

evidence.expected: Exact audit-selection provenance, one lossless bag, case metrics, V5 decision trace and snapshot, correction counters, post-correction progress, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.pass: Readiness gates pass, V5/V3 identities are exact, at least one corrective event is trace/snapshot-consistent, route arc grows afterward, and all storage hashes pass.
evidence.fail: Any source/selection/tool/image/checkpoint drift, planner failure, readiness failure, missing correction activation, no post-correction progress, archive failure or forbidden read.

estimated_cost.compute: One serial CPU/Gazebo closed-loop case; model inference only, zero training and zero GPU requirement.
